# List of international presidential trips made by Lee Jae Myung

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Lee Jae Myung, the 14th President of South Korea. During his presidency, which began with his inauguration on 4 June 2025.
Summary of presidential visits
The number of visits per country where he travelled are:
